goal: Build the reusable Storybook-first Edgebox shell and catalog interaction components with focused browser tests.
authority: User invoked run-wave for the two ready descendants of accepted add-edgebox-home-base architecture.

do_not: Edit src/lib/catalog, server/database files, application routes, root layout.css, or Pi infrastructure
Implement route data loading, authentication, preferences, or health checks
Create a parallel DTO model that conflicts with src/lib/catalog

criteria: Components start from the closest shadcn-svelte or headless accessible primitive
Stories cover meaningful success, empty, pending, failed, guest, member, operator, unavailable, and responsive states from the accepted journey inventory
Components remain server-agnostic and are suitable for direct route reuse
Focused browser tests cover keyboard/focus behavior and state-changing interactions without duplicating every story
